actualAuthorReading: All27 complete query objects,31 entries,73 senses, forms, restrictions, source notes and attributions actually read before freeze;14 Wikipedia pseudo-definitions not lexical evidence.
adjudication: パン bread sense and Portuguese pão adopted; prefix/pan/camera-panning/Greek Pan homographs are not adopted. Cookware contrast must be explicitly restricted to this bread sense, not a universal prohibition of パン for cookware.
カレー food entry 咖哩 adopted; separate JMnedict place-name entry and Wikipedia Curry pseudo-definition are not food-word authority.
コーヒー source notes name both English coffee and Dutch koffie; preserve both without inventing exclusive origin.
卵 biological broad sense spelling restriction and hen's-egg 玉子 usage are not a rigid raw/cooked opposition.
魚 retains primaryさかな/N5 and qualified additionalうお; 果物 retains whole-wordくだもの jukujikun, not a freely reusableくだ reading.
Food scope does not adopt 野菜 cannabis slang or unrelated historical, figurative and homographic senses.
Frozen editorial JLPT values preserved: 食事4 despite captured3; 塩5 despite1/5; 魚5 despite3/5; しょうゆ5 despite2/5.
Mixed meal formations and polite prefixes retain source technical types; no invented all-kun or two-kanji analysis.
しょうゆ remains the actual kana-only canonical path with kanji: []; body 醤油 spelling does not authorize an invented 醤油 card.
